request.current_plan: Build blue-red-green tower. Verify visual evidence before existing skills; reobserve uncertainty, retry failed grasps, escalate conflicts.

allowed_actions.continue: At initial_observation: table_fit_valid is true and all three colors are visible NOW. At verify_grasp: grasp_confirmed is true. Start or resume the frozen visual skill.
allowed_actions.reobserve: Acquire fresh RGB-D when evidence is missing and observation budget remains.
allowed_actions.retry_grasp: Only at verify_grasp, when grasp_confirmed is explicitly false and retries remain. Never choose this during initial_observation.
allowed_actions.escalate: Request a revised plan when evidence conflicts, budget is exhausted, or no action fits.
allowed_actions.stop: Stop this task when recovery is unavailable.

request.constraint: Write a conditional, phase-specific rule, not a statement that the current snapshot stays true. CURRENT observation always overrides old snapshot facts. A repaired plan requires a fresh observation before motion.
